prompt: Photograph of an architect's presentation model on a dark green self-healing cutting mat. A white model of a bank vault: a thick round vault door set in a square block, built from clean white foamboard and museum card with crisp knife-cut edges. The door has three separate keyholes. Three oversized flat keys cut from card lie in front of it, each carried by tiny scale-model figures of a man in a navy suit. Exactly one key is bright cutter-yellow; the other two keys are white. Three-quarter elevated view. Soft north-window daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows on the mat, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, studio product photography. The mat is plain deep green with only a very faint fine grid. No text, no numbers, no logos, no hands, no tools.
